name: Kosei Architects
description: Kosei Architects is a block theme for an architecture studio working on workplaces, housing and renovation. The home page opens on a framed panel grid with a timber-model photograph and diagonal bands beside a numbered index list, then shows a wall of finished buildings read as question, work and result, a ruled services table, a darkened parallax interlude, the fees on a ruled grid and notch and arch photographs. It declares WooCommerce support and works fully without WooCommerce installed. Source Serif 4 with Source Sans 3; blue-grey (#5C6A78) only on small marks. WCAG AA colours.
